limits: Static preview root height 0.35 m on air/transitions shows local posture, not world takeoff/touchdown completion.
Ground stepping is light with fixed torso/head; looking is a very small beak-direction change.
Landing absorption is light; distant framing weakens its difference from steady landing.

Named motion previews use neutral context; a separate actual fixed-root comparison reviewed flap/glide under constant climb/left/right/brake inputs. No external route or time-varying route was visually reviewed.
Shared pose endpoint equality and 116 composable connections are numerical checks; these captures do not show an external route playing every possible sequence.
Hsinlung has not accepted the motion acting style.
